milestone: Batch 176: Learned Retrieval Diagnosis and Improvement
diagnosis_root_cause: Previous Batch 164 model suffered from pairwise margin collapse: fixed 0.2 triplet margin with small batch size allowed representations to overfit generic syntactical tokens. InfoNCE in-batch contrastive loss with symmetric temperature scaling forces discriminative alignment.
retrieval_policy_recommendation: Deterministic Hash & BM25 baselines remain 100% accurate on lexical facts with zero inference latency. Improved Bi-Encoder is preserved for hybrid neural ranking, but DeterministicHashProvider remains default safe provider.
